title: Soar The Skies
description: Adds an Enchantment to make your Happy Ghasts go faster
body:
# Enchant your harnesses!
Enchant your harnesses with **Soaring**! Each level gives a 20% speed boost, with up to a maximum of 3. 

# Important Note
You must use a harness that was crafted after this datapack was added, otherwise they won't work in the enchanting table. You can convert old harnesses by placing them in the crafting grid. You will know if it's enchantable if the tooltip says "Enchantable".
